# Pinned, because the drift gate compares GENERATED BYTES. Pillow's PNG encoder output is not
# stable across its own releases: 12.3.0 re-encodes every one of the 62 chrome images to
# different bytes for identical pixels, so an unpinned install turns somebody else's upload
# into a red run here with nothing changed in this repository.
#
# Bumping either line means regenerating hud/ with the new version and committing the result in
# the same change, which is the point: a re-encode is a real change to files this repo serves.
pillow==12.2.0
PyYAML==6.0.3
